articles.summary: Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. articles.title: PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model

Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. articles.title: LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition
articles.summary: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. articles.summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. articles.summary: Data-driven weather forecasting requires distinguishing local states and their temporal evolution.
